rounds.text: Vinyas Innovative Technologies Ltd demonstrates exceptional compounding, with 5-year compounded profit growth at an astonishing 91% and trailing twelve-month profit growth at 59% [E15, E17]. This stellar earnings expansion is supported by robust top-line momentum, featuring a 30% compounded sales growth over both the last 3 years and the trailing twelve months [E13, E14]. Operational efficiency is also improving, as evidenced by the operating margin rising to 12% in March 2026 from 9% three years prior [E22]. Furthermore, institutional investors recognize this fundamental strength, driving positive money flow with domestic institutions increasing their stake to 6.53% in March 2026 from 3.24% in March 2024, alongside foreign institutional accumulation [E35, E36]. Rules-based screening explicitly validates this potential, awarding the company an 85 out of 100 BUY score backed by surging year-over-year sales and a 120% jump in net profit [E55, E56, E58]. Conceded: [E1, E2, E26, E37, E38].
